findings.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy header
findings.detail: Allows a broader range of injected scripts/styles to execute if XSS exists.

findings.title: Missing Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS) header
findings.detail: Site can be downgraded to plain HTTP, enabling traffic interception.

findings.title: Missing X-Frame-Options header
findings.detail: Page can be embedded in an <iframe>, enabling clickjacking attacks.

findings.title: Missing X-Content-Type-Options header
findings.detail: Browser may MIME-sniff responses, enabling certain content-spoofing attacks.
